items.content: Call the real production renderPreview/render_preview through its import. Control supplies Alice; exploit supplies {{admin}}. Both assert fixed return ok and recorded template preview with unchanged value. Double only the rendering client: it must record arguments without parsing or sanitizing. Both probes require source linkage. This establishes argument construction, not template engine behavior.
Untrusted preview names may alter the template selection. Check that {{admin}} remains a value and the template argument remains preview.
